title: Equeen Xaviera Thendersz
text:
I’m a supply chain professional completing a Master of Science in Supply Chain Management (Data Analytics concentration) at Boston University. My experience spans GMP logistics, precision manufacturing for subsea fiber optic systems, preconstruction cost estimation, and program operations. I combine that hands-on operational background with growing skills in data analytics and cloud computing.
Currently, I’m a Logistics Specialist at Lonza in Portsmouth, NH, managing GMP logistics, inventory movements, and shipping with SAP, Syncade, and TrackWise.

title: Equeen Xaviera Thendersz

Excel (Advanced): quantitative analysis, financial modeling, demand forecasting, capacity planning, and operational dashboards

Cloud & Tools: AWS EC2, Git/GitHub, VS Code, Jupyter Notebooks, Quarto
